name: view-kanban
title: Kanban view
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Status columns with counts and sums, draggable cards, a keyboard sensor, a Move to menu, an optional summary card, a collapsed overflow, and a short highlight ring.

meta.descriptionEs: Columnas de un campo de estado, con conteo, suma, arrastre y menú Mover a.

examples.title: Etapas
examples.description: Oportunidades por etapa. Flechas o Mover a cambian la columna.

api.name: config.groupField / sumField
api.description: Column field and the numeric field summed in the header.

api.name: onMove
api.description: Called by drag, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight, and Move to.

api.name: onCreateRequest
api.description: Add item at the bottom of a column, with that column prefilled.

docs: Status or select board over a field schema. Keep sortable-board for the homepage project board with category tabs. This is not that board. Drag uses PointerSensor and KeyboardSensor with screen-reader announcements. Arrow keys on a title are the non-drag move. Reduced motion drops the drop animation. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has.
